ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key, null'. 18 duplicate-key warnings fire on load/tab-switch. Key is null so cannot be traced to a single list from console; likely a list rendered with key={item.mint} or similar where a null mint sneaks in. Grep of /app/frontend/src/components/cockpit shows all cockpit lists use safe keys (ViewTabs id, TempoPill c, SkipTicker `${rep}-${it.key}`, CompactLadder t.key, CompactCandidates `${c.chain}-${c.mint}`) so source is outside cockpit — check TradeHistory / launch-feed / scanner / ladder / scorecard / greylist / reentry map()s for a nullable key.
1 x 401 on initial WS handshake + 'closed before established' warning at page load; app recovers (WS LIVE indicator shows green, ticker feed works). Likely token attach timing / cookie vs bearer.

action_items: Track down the null-keyed list responsible for 'two children with the same key `null`' warning (list is outside /components/cockpit/ — likely TradeHistory, LaunchFeed, or one of the SCAN sections). Adding `key={x.mint || x.id || idx}` on the offending map() will silence it.
critical_code_review_comments: SkipTicker doubles the list for seamless scroll (map twice with rep index) — fine, but if list.length === 0 the track is empty and counter still reads 0; acceptable but worth a visual placeholder.

CompactCandidates uses `${c.chain}-${c.mint}`; if two feeds emit the same chain+mint (very possible for pumpfun candidates seen twice) this collides. Consider adding a monotonic seq or ts as tiebreaker.
